title: Community post (1 year ago, approx date)
summary: Channel update explaining the lack of uploads: the School of Strategy drew more than double the expected sign-ups, plus immigration bureaucracy, delaying his return to full-time content.
claims: The School of Strategy (his paid coaching programme) attracted more than twice the number of members he expected, pushing back his return to regular YouTube content
As an immigrant he was dealing with bureaucracy issues that further slowed content production
He feels he does owe his audience an explanation for upload gaps, even if some viewers say he doesn't
He wants to balance YouTube with giving paying clients the quality of service they deserve
